events.title: US-Japan Coordinated Yen Intervention — First in Over a Decade
events.summary: US Treasury and Japan MOF conducted coordinated yen-buying intervention on Friday July 31. US sold euros to buy yen — first joint US-Japan currency intervention in over 10 years. Yen at 40-year lows. Trump confirmed intervention. Tokyo signals readiness for further action.

events.title: 2026 Iran War — Strait of Hormuz Crisis Active, Oil Supply Disrupted
events.summary: Active US-Iran military conflict with retaliatory missile/drone strikes on US embassies, military installations, and oil infrastructure. Strait of Hormuz partially blocked — 20% of global oil/LNG traffic affected. Brent crude jumped 10-13%, potentially heading to $100+/bbl. Houthi threats to join war. Kuwait and UK reporting attacks on shipping.

events.title: WHO Declares Ebola Outbreak (Bundibugyo strain) Public Health Emergency of International Concern
events.summary: WHO declared the 2026 Ebola outbreak in DRC and Uganda a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) on May 17, 2026. Bundibugyo ebolavirus — no existing vaccines or treatments available. Fastest-growing Ebola outbreak on record as of late July 2026.

events.title: Russia Systemic Banking Crisis Risk — Sberbank Warns of Rising Bad Loans
events.summary: Kremlin-linked think tank CMASF warns Russia could face systemic banking crisis by October 2026. Sberbank warns of rising corporate credit risks — 11.7% of corporate loans problematic. Wildberries collapse dragging down VTB and Sberbank. Bankruptcies up 13.7% YoY.

events.title: Fed Holds Rates in Divided 9-3 Vote — Three Dissents Signal Deep Policy Conflict
events.summary: Fed kept rates at 3.5-3.75% in a 9-3 vote on July 29. New Chairman Kevin Warsh vowed to fight persistent inflation. Three officials dissented. Market uncertainty high.

events.title: Japan-South Korea Rare Joint FX Intervention — First in 15 Years
events.summary: Japan and South Korea conducted unprecedented coordinated FX intervention — first joint action in 15 years. US possibly participated. Raises yen carry trade volatility. Asian currency markets under stress.
